title: Rival Channel Minecraft City
description: I've added the Arknights battle channel gameplay to my Minecraft.
body:
# 1.Betting Duel
- Players must pick the team they believe will win. The duel continues until only one player remains or the round ends.
- There is a “protection” mechanic for the first 5 rounds: if you make a wrong guess, your protection is lost; after round 5, protection is disabled for everyone.
# 2.Gift Duel
- Each player starts with 2000 funds, ranked by total funds; the player with the most funds wins, and reaching 0 funds means elimination.
- From round 5 onward, an ALL option becomes available – players may choose ALL to wager all their current funds.
- The required bet amount increases each round, starting from 500. If a player does not have enough funds to meet the required bet for that round, they are automatically forced into ALL (i.e., they must bet all their remaining funds).
# 3.Diamond Betting Duel 
- Players can wager diamonds. The number of diamonds required to bet increases each round: round 1 requires 1 diamond, round 2 requires 2, and so on, up to round 10 which requires 10 diamonds.
- If the player’s chosen monster team wins, they receive a diamond reward. The reward also increases progressively: round 1 gives 3 diamonds, round 2 gives 4 (or as determined by the game’s progression), up to round 10 which gives 35 diamonds (intermediate values are scaled linearly or according to a predefined curve).
- If the bet is lost, the diamonds wagered for that round are consumed, and no reward is given.
